case_title.quote: STATE OF M.P. v. ASHOK & OTHERS ETC.

number_of_accused.correct_value: 5 (six respondents acquitted by the HC; Surendra's proceedings abated, leaving five)
number_of_accused.quote: proceedings stand abated as against said respondent no.6
number_of_accused.reason: Five is plausible after abatement, but the judgment never states this count; six respondents were named.

accused_gender.quote: Ashok s/o Banshilal Vedehi, Raju @ Rajendra s/o Banshilal Vedehi
accused_gender.reason: All respondents are described as sons ('s/o'), so male.

accused_caste.reason: No caste is stated; surnames are not caste descriptions.

victim_gender.quote: Tikaram son of Chote Lal Pandey

accused_victim_relationship.quote: There is an old enmity and quarrel was going on between us and Dibbu etc.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Accurately reflects the enmity described; no separate respondent relationship is stated.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.302 r/w s.149; s.147 (respondents); s.148 for Dibbu and Jittu
statutory_provisions.quote: found guilty under section 302 read with section 149 I.P.C. ... rigorous imprisonment for 6 month under section 147
statutory_provisions.reason: Right for respondents, but omits s.148 charged against the main accused.

weapon.correct_value: Petrol and matchstick (set afire), burning tyre, and sword
weapon.quote: Dibbu then poured petrol over him and Jittu burnt him by igniting a match stick
weapon.reason: Items are correct, but the sword attribution is inconsistent: the headnote says the original accused threw it, while the text names Harilal.

evidence_type.quote: Dying declarations namely statements Exts.P-20 and P-17, so also oral declarations ... and the eye-witness account through PW13

aggravating_circumstances.quote: they were waiting in ambush ... ensured by surrounding Tikaram that he would not be allowed to escape

trial_court_outcome.quote: All the other accused were sentenced to life imprisonment under section 302 read with section 149 I.P.C. and to rigorous imprisonment for 6 month under section 147

high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court however gave benefit of doubt to the respondents

final_outcome.quote: restore the judgment of conviction and sentence as recorded by the trial Court

offence_finally_established.quote: restore the judgment of conviction and sentence as recorded by the trial Court

imprisonment_type.quote: sentenced to life imprisonment under section 302 read with section 149

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove 'Before dying' references to the victim's death outcome and the charge sheet/investigation details are fine; but avoid 'persons' etc. Revise to eliminate the mention of the death date and gender pronouns.
neutral_facts.reason: Uses 'him/his' for the victim (acceptable) but the 'one member ... another' attribution is fine; however it states 'brother ran home' correctly. Main issue: it reveals no outcome, yet says 'one member threw a burning tyre' and 'another threw a sword' without the evidence nuance.

offence_severity.reason: Punishment not stated in the judgment.

attempt_completion.quote: On 12.04.1989 at about 8:15 p.m. Tikaram succumbed to his injuries

physical_harm.quote: The deceased was burnt about 90%. ... Incised wound obliquely on back of chest

number_of_offences.correct_value: 3 charged (s.302/149, s.147, s.148 across accused); for respondents 2 charged; 2 upheld
number_of_offences.quote: found guilty under section 302 read with section 149 ... section 147
number_of_offences.reason: For respondents 2 is right, but s.148 was also charged against other accused.

motive.quote: For taking revenge from the said enmity today they poured petrol on me

key_evidence_accepted.quote: Both these statements are consistent and name the present respondents

witness_credibility.quote: we find the presence of said PW13 completely established and accept him to be eye witness

trial_duration.reason: Dates correct; trial judgment date not given.

legal_representation.quote: Vanshaja Shukla, Mishra Saurabh for the Appellant. Akshat Shrivastava, Sarabjit Dutta for the Respondents.

investigation_status.quote: After due investigation charge sheet was filed and 10 accused persons were sent for trial

appeal_history.quote: We therefore allow these appeals, set-aside the judgment and order of acquittal

prosecution_argument.quote: the role of the present respondents ... clearly made out from the dying declarations as well as from the testimony of the eye witness

defence_argument.quote: the principal role as alleged in the dying declarations was not as regards the present respondents

legal_principle_applied.quote: The intent of the entire assembly was clear, eloquently established by their presence, preparedness and participation.

judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: throwing of burning tyre and the sword would also indicate the active role played by them

other_sentence_order.quote: The respondents shall be taken in custody forthwith
